Once I've extracted the vehicle, ''exterminate'' all witnesses.''"<br />"''With ''pleasure'', mighty ''Zorc''!|[[T'orn Zorc]] and a Black Sun foot soldier|<ref name="Under the Hammer">{{SWComicCite|7.6|Under the Hammer}}</ref>}}
'''Black Sun foot soldiers''' were [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in service of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were stationed at the [[Black Sun fortress/Legends|Black Sun fortress]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where they guarded [[Xomit Grunseit/Legends|Xomit Grunseit]] and the [[Black Sun ruling council/Legends|Black Sun ruling council]]. Their leader was [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]], who was the [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]]. Their weapon of choice was a [[Black Sun foot soldier blaster/Legends|double-barreled blaster]].

==History==
Several Black Sun soldiers were involved in a [[mission to Callos]], where they hoped to steal the starfighter ''[[Venomator]]''.<ref name="Under the Hammer">{{SWComicCite|7.6|Under the Hammer}}</ref>

[[File:Moj-TakeoverOnMandalore.png|thumb|left|250px|The foot soldiers wreak havoc in [[Peace Park/Legends|Peace Park]] during the Takeover on Mandalore.]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], allied with the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], arrived on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in order to force the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] to join them. After [[Xomit Grunseit/Legends|Xomit Grunseit]] and the other leaders refused to join, they were [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] by Opress. One of the guards was also killed. [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]] agreed to join forces with Maul and [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], thus forming the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]].

Afterwards, they participated in the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|Takeover of Mandalore]] with the forces of the Shadow Collective, including the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], in order to overthrow the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]], and make Vizsla the ruler of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. They attacked several locations around the city of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], overwhelming the [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian police]], until the Death Watch arrived to stage their capture.
